jobDescription: An investment manager is moving its private-client accounts from an ageing in-house system to a vendor wealth-management platform over two years. The programme manager runs delivery across the vendor, the data-conversion contractor and the client-service teams, controls scope within the limits the executive sponsor has delegated, makes the cutover decision against agreed criteria and keeps the decision and change log. The programme manager also works with marketing on how and when clients hear about the move, and the firm would like that planning to be led by the programme manager. The programme reports monthly to an executive sponsor from the private-client business and to the firm's change board.
requirements: Has led delivery of a platform migration, including scope control and the cutover decision.
Keeps the programme decision and change log.
Manages vendor and contractor milestones against the contract schedule.
Escalates scope changes beyond delegated limits to the executive sponsor.
Has led client-communication planning for a platform change.

evidence.text: Programme manager at Ashgrove Investment Partners from April 2020 to July 2024, delivery lead for moving 38,000 private-client accounts onto a vendor wealth-management platform.
Approved scope changes of up to ten person-days under the delegated authority set out in the programme charter, and took larger changes to the executive sponsor with an options paper.
Chaired the weekly milestone review with the platform vendor and the data-conversion contractor, recording slippage against the contract schedule and agreeing recovery dates.
Made the go decision for the final migration weekend in March 2024 against the charter's cutover criteria; the decision is entered in the decision log and countersigned by the executive sponsor.
Wrote the timeline and frequently-asked-questions sections of the client-communication plan, which the marketing team prepared and owned.

Work sample: extracts from the programme charter, whose role table lists the candidate under 'Delivery lead' with a ten person-day approval limit, and four pages of the decision log showing the candidate's sign-off on scope changes and on the March 2024 cutover decision.
HR verification note: employment at Ashgrove Investment Partners and the title Programme Manager were confirmed in writing by the employer's HR department.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate has a three-month notice period and would like an on-site day as part of the first interview round.

propositions.rationale: The resume states the decision and the decision-log pages show the sign-off.
